content.title: Kitchen Task Rhythm | Stir, Taste and Continuous Cooking Proof
content.summary: A camp cook proves one pan of beans through stirring and tasting. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One cook, pan and tool remain fixed. + Repeated stirring visibly changes the ingredients. + Heat evidence increases gradually. + The tasted bite comes from the cooked pan. + The final reaction follows swallowing and preserves the finished dish.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show one adult camp cook stirring beans and squash in one iron pan over a fixed stove. Let the ingredients soften and coat evenly without changing pans or burners. End with the cook nodding toward camera and holding the same spoon beside the finished pan.
